_comment: Hook blocks for the Temper guardrails pack. Hooks in a settings file get no CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT variable, so /temper:pack enable guardrails replaces that variable in each command with the plugin's absolute folder, in double quotes, when it merges these blocks into the project's .claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.local.json. To copy them by hand, make the same replacement. The stage-gate pair (stage-marker.sh and verify-stage-gate.sh) is not here: it runs as the plugin's own hooks. Claude Code has no PreCommit event, so these blocks cover only what the agent does (edits, writes, Bash). The native git pre-commit hook that /temper:init installs by running bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/guards/install.sh is the gate on every raw git commit. The pack's rules are in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/packs/guardrails/rules.md
